eps.ov: Gen’s peaceful solo camping trip is interrupted by a first timer without a tent.
Shizuku insists on camping with Gen until she's comfortable camping solo, so they go solo camping together.
Gen and Shizuku go shopping for camping gear together.

eps.t: What Do You Do While Camping?
eps.ov: Shizuku is unable to explain why she wants to go camping alone, so she asks Gen for his thoughts.
Gen examines his feelings on camping with Shizuku, while Akihito hangs out with Shizuku and her friends.
Gen teaches Shizuku the basics of campfires.
Gen thinks back on his camping experiences and when he started camping solo.
Gen is appalled by the state of Shizuku's backpack and teaches her how to pack properly.
Shizuku embarks on her first multi-day camping trip with Gen.
Shizuku runs into Gen's old flame.
Gen and Kana reflect on their relationship and breakup.
Shizuku and her friends have a cookout to prepare for their upcoming cottage camping trip.

eps.t: What Do You Think of Shizuku?
eps.ov: Shizuku explores a new way to enjoy the outdoors by cottage camping with her friends.
Gen meets a bicycle camper while enjoying some time outdoors.

eps.t: Camping Like Ships Passing in the Night
eps.ov: Akihito and Gen reconnect and reaffirm their friendship over their shared interest in camping.
Gen asks Shizuku to choose their next campsite.

eps.t: You Don't Mind If I Take Him, Right?
eps.ov: While checking out a new campfire stand at a camping supply store, Gen runs into Yui.
Yui returns from her bike ride to an awkward and strained atmosphere at the campsite.
Gen decides to tell Shizuku about his dream but finds it difficult to broach the subject.

eps.t: I Don't Want to Graduate Yet
eps.ov: Gen gives Shizuku a gift to celebrate one year of solo camping for two.
Gen advises Shizuku on how to choose a hard cooler, and Shizuku teaches Gen about the wonders of Dutch ovens.
Shizuku reevaluates what she wants to do with her future.

eps.t: Are You Giving It Serious Thought?
eps.ov: When Shizuku, Gen, Yui, and Kai end up camping together, they try to make the best of an awkward situation.
Shizuku decides what she wants to do about her vaguely-defined relationship with Gen.
